note: All rows are PREPARED checks, not earned play. Save = completed camp prepared in-page from the recorded earned completion (sequel-progression-checks.json; the raw earned save is not in this environment), reloaded through migration; threat written into the save; raid started with the visible button; real time. Recorded crews: Wave4 arch3+arch3+ballista3[armour], Wave9 arch6+arch6+ballista3[armour] at the recorded anchors (the earned completion used click assistance). Budget counter = 4th slot (≤ squad size) + one squad one step + policy/placement. Assist = one visible click on an enemy (a selected tree otherwise takes Space), then Space 4/s, default aim. Flank road/boss seed = wave number (in play: the run number).

coinFormula: entitlement = floor((Σ_wave max_over_threat[(floor(10·bestKills/total) + 10·cleared) × (1 + 0.5·threat)] + min(10, 2·clearedWaves, trainingBest)) / 5); award = entitlement − claimed (claimed only grows).
browserVsModel: Same positions, stats, step order and ~1/30 s step (checked in page). Differences come from initial cooldowns (seeded by body key + encounter id) and variable frame dt; at the edge (Wave9 threat 0, 4-slot crew) one runner flips 3/3 ↔ 2/3. The model therefore uses jittered dt (1/60–0.1 s) and 4 seeds; damage per squad agrees within ~8% and assist damage within ~5%.

rush.method: Rush changes no combat rule: same crew → same result (browser row W4-rush-rec vs model W4 threat 0). Its effect is less preparation income. Estimate, not a measured playthrough: one conveyor carries about 0.77 items/s (dev docs, M3/M4 notes), so 30 s less preparation is at most ~23 wood and ~23 stone per wave on a two-belt camp.
rush.perWave: ~23 wood + ~23 stone ≈ 2/3 of one 3→6 step, or 1/2 of one 6→10 step
rush.perRun: 8 preparations × 30 s ≈ 184 wood / 184 stone ≈ 4 training steps over a full run
rush.combatConsequence: One step is exactly the budget that separates the losing recorded crew from the winning counter in the threat-1 tables (e.g. Wave4 ironhide/shieldwall/siege: upper archers 3→6; Wave9 horde/thin: lower archers 6→10). Under rush the player must have that step's materials stocked earlier, or automate more before the run.
rush.unresolved: Not measured with a live economy in the browser (the prepared save has no working conveyors).
